name: Taiki, Kiriha, & Nene
main_effect:
[Start of Your Main Phase] By placing 1 Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] or [Blue Flare] trait from your hand under this Tamer, gain 1 memory and ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
[Your Turn] When you would play 1 Digimon card with a DigiXros requirement, by suspending this Tamer, you may place cards from under your Tamers as digivolution cards for a DigiXros.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
